CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,name VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,email VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,role VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,department VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL,joinedAt VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL,UNIQUE KEY users_email(email)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS projects (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,name VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,description TEXT NOT NULL,code VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL,category VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,priority VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL,ownerId VARCHAR(64),progress INT NOT NULL,dueDate VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL,createdAt VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL,updatedAt VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL,completedAt VARCHAR(24),color VARCHAR(7) NOT NULL,UNIQUE KEY projects_code(code),CONSTRAINT fk_project_owner FOREIGN KEY(ownerId) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,CHECK(progress BETWEEN 0 AND 100)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS activities (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,actor VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,action VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,target VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL,type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,createdAt VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL,INDEX activities_date(createdAt)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS settings (id INT PRIMARY KEY,value TEXT NOT NULL,CHECK(id=1)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions (tokenHash CHAR(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin PRIMARY KEY,expiresAt BIGINT NOT NULL,INDEX sessions_expiry(expiresAt)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS login_attempts (`key` VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,count INT NOT NULL,windowStart BIGINT NOT NULL) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS studio_scripts (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,title VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,synopsis TEXT NOT NULL,genre VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,content MEDIUMTEXT NOT NULL,wordCount INT NOT NULL,revision INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,sourceName VARCHAR(255),createdAt VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL,updatedAt VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL,CHECK(status IN ('草稿','创作中','已定稿','已归档')),CHECK(revision>0)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS studio_characters (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,scriptId VARCHAR(64),name VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,role VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,description TEXT NOT NULL,appearance TEXT NOT NULL,personality TEXT NOT NULL,createdAt VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL,updatedAt VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL,coverAssetId VARCHAR(64),CONSTRAINT fk_character_script FOREIGN KEY(scriptId) REFERENCES studio_scripts(id) ON DELETE SET NULL) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS studio_assets (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,characterId VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,originalName VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,mimeType VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,size INT NOT NULL,width INT NOT NULL,height INT NOT NULL,createdAt VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL,CONSTRAINT fk_asset_character FOREIGN KEY(characterId) REFERENCES studio_characters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS studio_activities (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,actor VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,action VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,target VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL,type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,createdAt VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL,INDEX studio_activity_date(createdAt)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS studio_agent_keys (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,name VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL,prefix VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL,tokenHash CHAR(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,permission VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL,createdAt VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL,lastUsedAt VARCHAR(24),expiresAt VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL,UNIQUE KEY agent_token(tokenHash),CHECK(permission IN ('read','write'))) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS studio_migrations (id INT PRIMARY KEY) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS data_migrations (id VARCHAR(100) PRIMARY KEY,completedAt VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS studio_asset_storage (assetId VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,bucket VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,region VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,objectKey VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL,versionId VARCHAR(256),createdAt VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL,CONSTRAINT fk_asset_storage FOREIGN KEY(assetId) REFERENCES studio_assets(id) ON DELETE CASCADE) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS studio_storage_cleanup (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,assetId VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,storageType VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,bucket VARCHAR(128),region VARCHAR(64),objectKey VARCHAR(512),versionId VARCHAR(256),reason VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,nextAttemptAt VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL,attempts INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,lastError VARCHAR(120),createdAt VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL,INDEX storage_cleanup_due(nextAttemptAt),CHECK(storageType IN ('cos','local'))) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS admin_accounts (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,username VARCHAR(80) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,passwordHash VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,name VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,role VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,isActive BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,createdAt VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL,updatedAt VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL,UNIQUE KEY admin_username(username)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS admin_sessions (tokenHash CHAR(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin PRIMARY KEY,userId VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,expiresAt BIGINT NOT NULL,INDEX admin_session_expiry(expiresAt),CONSTRAINT fk_admin_session_account FOREIGN KEY(userId) REFERENCES admin_accounts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
